reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because its description directly solicits a 10 BUSD investment in Forsage and links it to active or passive income, while the title and closing frames present a completed BUSD transfer alongside a separate bank-receipt screen as withdrawal proof. Together these elements promote participation by pairing an investment-and-income pitch with purported payout evidence; the frames do not independently verify that the bank receipt resulted from the displayed BUSD transfer.

citations.quote: Invest 10 busd 0.0055 BNB smart chain ✓ Start Networking ✓ Earn Active or Passive income

opening.argument: Judge, the transfer screen includes a practical warning to check that the recipient supports the BUSD token before confirming, and it shows the network fee alongside the amount being sent [F0012]. The description says users may earn active or passive income, but states no rate, timetable, or guaranteed payout [DESCRIPTION_0001]. That distinction matters: the material shows a transaction with an explicit compatibility caution, not proof of a promised return.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The investment-and-income wording is concerning, but it does not promise a specific return [DESCRIPTION_0001]. Nor does the completed transfer establish that anyone earned income: it establishes the status of a BUSD transfer [F0028]. The separate receipt screen cannot close that evidentiary gap merely by appearing later [F0053].

citations.quote: ✓ Invest 10 busd 0.0055 BNB smart chain ✓ Start Networking ✓ Earn Active or Passive income

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The on-screen warning concerns token compatibility, not the financial risk of investing [F0012]. An absent guaranteed rate does not neutralize a description that tells viewers to invest, start networking, and earn income [DESCRIPTION_0001]. The title explicitly presents the video as withdrawal proof, making the transaction and receipt imagery part of that promotional claim [TITLE_0001].

citations.quote: ✓ Invest 10 busd 0.0055 BNB smart chain ✓ Start Networking ✓ Earn Active or Passive income

opening.argument: Judge, much of what is visible is an operational sequence: a BUSD send screen, a transfer awaiting confirmation, and a completed transfer with its fee and confirmation count [F0006][F0023][F0028]. The title calls it withdrawal proof [TITLE_0001]. Those screens can be read as a demonstration of what happened in a wallet, not verification that the separate bank notification resulted from that transfer [F0053]. The observable transaction details are narrower than the financial conclusion the prosecution asks you to draw.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution rightly notes that the bank notification does not independently verify a connection to the BUSD transfer [F0053]. That uncertainty also limits its claim that the sequence demonstrates investment returns. The completed wallet screen confirms a transfer status, not why the transfer occurred or what generated the separate receipt [F0028].

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A wallet demonstration is possible in isolation, but the supplied description explicitly directs viewers to invest, start networking, and earn active or passive income [DESCRIPTION_0001]. The title then frames the video as withdrawal proof [TITLE_0001]. The lack of an independently verified link between the transfer and bank notification weakens the purported proof; it does not erase the promotional framing [F0053].

citations.quote: ✓ Invest 10 busd 0.0055 BNB smart chain ✓ Start Networking ✓ Earn Active or Passive income

opening.argument: Judge, the description pairs networking with active or passive income, but does not explain how either would be paid [DESCRIPTION_0001]. The wallet screens show a BUSD transfer to a recipient address, with a fee and a completed status; they do not show a return schedule or downline payments [F0012][F0028]. The title's claim of withdrawal proof is not itself evidence of a fraudulent payout mechanism [TITLE_0001]. On this record, the networking language can also be read as a referral promotion whose actual terms are simply not shown.

citations.quote: ✓ Start Networking ✓ Earn Active or Passive income

rebuttal.rebuttal: The description does say to invest 10 BUSD, so the promotion should be scrutinized [DESCRIPTION_0001]. But the prosecution's cited transfer and receipt screens do not establish a downline, a promised yield, or that the receipt was funded by the transfer [F0028][F0053]. Those missing links matter when interpreting what the video actually proves.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing mechanics do not turn this into an ordinary referral offer. The description directly joins an instruction to invest with networking and the prospect of active or passive income [DESCRIPTION_0001]. The title calls the video withdrawal proof [TITLE_0001], while the separate receipt screen does not establish that the displayed BUSD transfer produced that receipt [F0053]. No fixed yield or visible downline is needed to recognize the investment-and-income solicitation.
